hso4i2.q: Electrically powered devices and equipment (radio, lights, heated rear window, etc.) increase the vehicle's fuel consumption.
hso4i2.why: Every electrical load draws power from the alternator, which takes power from the engine, so fuel consumption rises.

bdzwgy.q: By keeping speed as constant as possible, fuel consumption is reduced.
bdzwgy.why: A steady speed avoids repeated accelerating and braking, which waste fuel, so consumption drops.

yvbeqo.q: Fuel consumption increases as the weight of the vehicle increases.
yvbeqo.why: A heavier vehicle needs more energy to get moving and keep moving, so it burns more fuel.

1metirg.q: Appropriately reducing speed reduces fuel consumption.
1metirg.why: Air resistance rises sharply with speed, so a more moderate pace lowers fuel consumption.

1qjr221.q: To use less fuel, it is advisable to keep the windows closed, especially when travelling at high speed.
1qjr221.why: Open windows worsen aerodynamics and increase air drag, especially at high speed, which raises fuel use.

1vmphhu.q: To use less fuel, it is better to choose, as far as possible, flat and free-flowing roads.
1vmphhu.why: Hills demand more power and heavy traffic forces stop-and-go driving, so flat, free-flowing roads use less fuel.

18rl46f.q: Insufficient tyre inflation pressure leads to higher fuel consumption.
18rl46f.why: An under-inflated tyre has greater rolling resistance, so the engine uses more fuel.

1113yy3.q: Placing luggage on the roof of the vehicle leads to higher fuel consumption.
1113yy3.why: Roof luggage worsens aerodynamics and adds weight, so fuel consumption goes up.

kkxs8n.q: Keeping the vehicle's sunroof open leads to lower fuel consumption.
kkxs8n.why: An open sunroof creates turbulence and increases air drag, so consumption rises rather than falls.

1vkt8bm.q: Using the air conditioning leads to lower fuel consumption.
1vkt8bm.why: The air-conditioning compressor takes power from the engine, so using it increases fuel consumption.

1078fvt.q: Hybrid vehicles (with two engines, combustion and electric) pollute more because they are driven by two engines.
1078fvt.why: Hybrids combine the two engines to cut fuel use and emissions, so they pollute less than a combustion-only vehicle.

gtkijz.q: To use less fuel, it is advisable to put luggage on the roof of the vehicle.
gtkijz.why: Roof luggage increases air drag and weight; to save fuel, luggage should go in the boot (bagagliaio).

1ojp7um.q: To use less fuel, it is better to accelerate and brake hard.
1ojp7um.why: Hard acceleration and braking waste fuel; smooth driving and anticipating traffic use less.

1e0yxu7.q: To avoid annoying noise while driving, you must have the silencer (marmitta) checked to make sure it is in good working condition.
1e0yxu7.why: A damaged silencer makes the vehicle noisier, so it must be kept in good order through regular checks.

kz4l5l.q: Noise pollution increases if audible warning devices (horn, trumpets) are used excessively.
kz4l5l.why: The horn is a source of noise, so overusing it adds to noise pollution.

1oqj1r3.q: To avoid annoying noise while driving, you should not brake sharply unless strictly necessary.
1oqj1r3.why: Sharp braking makes brakes and tyres squeal; braking gradually reduces noise.

1gb17b9.q: To avoid annoying noise, you should not rev the engine needlessly and repeatedly when the vehicle is stationary.
1gb17b9.why: Revving a stationary vehicle only creates needless noise and fuel use, so it should be avoided.

sc2d8a.q: To avoid annoying noise while driving, the horn must be used only for road safety reasons (transporting injured or sick people, immediate danger).
sc2d8a.why: The horn is for real safety needs only, such as immediate danger or transporting injured or sick people.

txn8yq.q: To avoid annoying noise during stops caused by traffic, you must keep the engine running and rev it repeatedly.
txn8yq.why: Repeated revving while stopped increases noise, fuel use and pollution, so it should not be done in traffic stops.

14q8yix.q: To avoid annoying noise, you must slam the car doors shut so that you do not have to close them again.
14q8yix.why: Slamming doors makes a loud noise; they should be closed firmly but without force.

1or66wd.q: To avoid annoying noise while driving, you must replace the horn with flashing lights, but only at night.
1or66wd.why: The horn may be used when there is danger; flashing lights are the night-time signal outside built-up areas, not a rule for avoiding noise.

2az4qg.q: The noise produced by motor vehicles increases as the silencer (marmitta) deteriorates.
2az4qg.why: The silencer muffles exhaust noise, so as it deteriorates its effect weakens and the vehicle gets louder.

tq1olm.q: The noise produced by motor vehicles can be reduced by correct driving that avoids sharp braking and strong acceleration.
tq1olm.why: Smooth driving without sharp braking or hard acceleration lowers the noise a vehicle makes.

14zivor.q: The noise produced by motor vehicles is caused only by the engine.
14zivor.why: Noise also comes from tyres, brakes, exhaust, suspension, load and air flow, not just the engine.

gij6q9.q: To reduce the noise emitted by motor vehicles, the silencer (marmitta) must be efficient and of an approved type.
gij6q9.why: A silencer only reduces noise if it is working properly and approved for that vehicle.

1rei1ib.q: To reduce noise, a damaged silencer must be replaced with one approved for that type of vehicle.
1rei1ib.why: A damaged silencer must be replaced with one approved for that vehicle type to keep noise down.

izb9qu.q: To reduce noise, you should not rev the engine when the vehicle is stationary.
izb9qu.why: Revving while stationary produces needless noise, so avoiding it reduces noise.

17sbc7.q: To reduce the noise produced by motor vehicles, the brakes must be checked if they make noise when braking, and replaced if necessary.
17sbc7.why: Squealing brakes signal wear or faults; checking and, if needed, replacing them cuts noise.

122y33a.q: Checking brakes that make noise not only increases safety but can also reduce the vehicle's noisiness.
122y33a.why: Inspecting noisy brakes improves safety and can also make the vehicle quieter.

tgo9mi.q: To reduce the noise emitted by motor vehicles, the horn should be sounded as little as possible.
tgo9mi.why: The horn is a source of noise, so it should be used as little as possible and only when needed.

j32ovp.q: To reduce the noise emitted by motor vehicles, it is advisable to drill holes in the silencer (marmitta).
j32ovp.why: Drilling holes in the silencer impairs it and increases noise; it is also an unauthorised modification.

1ml1fmk.q: To reduce the noise emitted by motor vehicles, you must replace the exhaust pipe with one of smaller diameter.
1ml1fmk.why: A smaller exhaust pipe does not cut noise and harms the engine; an efficient, approved silencer is what is needed.

17ca7q1.q: To reduce the noise emitted by motor vehicles, it is enough to remove the end part of the silencer (marmitta).
17ca7q1.why: Removing part of the silencer makes the vehicle louder and alters an exhaust system that must stay approved.

1ovpj9l.q: In corners taken at high speed, tyre skidding increases the noisiness of the vehicle.
1ovpj9l.why: In fast corners the tyres slide and squeal, making the vehicle noisier.

2gnw6a.q: Empty trailers that bounce excessively can be a cause of noise.
2gnw6a.why: Empty trailers bounce over road irregularities and create noise from knocks and vibrations.

d7e134.q: To reduce pollution caused by vehicles, you must not accelerate abruptly when pulling away.
d7e134.why: Abrupt starts increase fuel use and emissions; accelerating gradually pollutes less.

7kc0w1.q: To reduce pollution, you must avoid keeping a low gear engaged for too long if it is not necessary.
7kc0w1.why: A low gear keeps engine revs high, raising fuel use and emissions, so use it only when needed.

ofbzh6.q: To reduce air pollution caused by petrol-engine vehicles, the catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica) must be replaced when it is worn out or exhausted.
ofbzh6.why: An exhausted catalytic converter no longer cleans the exhaust gases, so it must be replaced to limit pollution.

h99hkq.q: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must frequently check the clutch and the differential.
h99hkq.why: The clutch and differential do not affect emissions; the engine, filters, catalytic converter and fuel system do.

17v74yl.q: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must frequently check the suspension components (shock absorbers).
17v74yl.why: Suspension affects handling and comfort, not the engine's polluting emissions.

14weftl.q: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must reduce the tyre inflation pressure.
14weftl.why: Under-inflated tyres raise rolling resistance, fuel use and emissions; pressure must be kept at the correct value.

1dsf9al.q: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must repeatedly rev the engine from standstill to keep it warm and improve its efficiency.
1dsf9al.why: Revving at standstill raises fuel use and emissions with no benefit; the engine warms up by driving smoothly.

1pzukb9.q: In vehicles fitted with a catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica), air pollution is lower immediately after starting the engine, when the temperature is still low.
1pzukb9.why: The catalytic converter works well only at operating temperature, so pollution is higher from a cold start.

14depja.q: Air pollution produced by vehicles can depend on irregular engine operation.
14depja.why: An engine running irregularly burns fuel poorly and produces more polluting emissions.

1qwz64a.q: Air pollution can be reduced by checking that the vehicle is always in optimal condition for consumption and performance.
1qwz64a.why: A well-maintained, well-tuned vehicle uses less fuel and emits less.

ggsn0v.q: By adopting a driving style that limits fuel consumption, it is possible to reduce air pollution.
ggsn0v.why: Burning less fuel means fewer emissions, so economical driving cuts pollution.

df6968.q: Atmospheric pollution produced by vehicles can be reduced by checking that the air filter is not dirty or clogged.
df6968.why: A dirty air filter upsets the air-fuel mixture and raises fuel use and emissions, so it must be checked and replaced when needed.

pc7lug.q: Atmospheric pollution produced by vehicles disappears entirely when accelerating flat out, because the high temperature makes the fuel burn quickly.
pc7lug.why: Flat-out acceleration increases fuel use and emissions; no driving condition eliminates pollution.

1woxswj.q: Air pollution produced by vehicles decreases if the air conditioning is left on.
1woxswj.why: Running the air conditioning makes the engine work harder, raising fuel use and emissions.

ramlq2.q: Atmospheric pollution is zero in vehicles that comply with the "Euro 0" anti-pollution standard.
ramlq2.why: No combustion-engine vehicle has zero emissions, and Euro 0 is the least strict, most polluting class.

k52cib.q: Air pollution produced by vehicles increases if the injectors are faulty.
k52cib.why: Faulty injectors disturb combustion, causing higher fuel use and more emissions.

5kmxvj.q: Greater smoke emission from the exhaust is a symptom of greater pollution caused by the engine.
5kmxvj.why: More exhaust smoke shows poor combustion and therefore higher polluting emissions.

1c63jw1.q: Air pollution caused by vehicles is greater if the exhaust smoke is dark in colour.
1c63jw1.why: Dark smoke means incomplete combustion, so the engine releases more soot (particolato) and other pollutants.

yugsz5.q: Air pollution caused by vehicles can cause damage to the respiratory tract and eye irritation.
yugsz5.why: Exhaust pollutants irritate the eyes and airways and can harm the respiratory system.

kv9fcr.q: Air pollution caused by vehicles increases smog, acid rain and the greenhouse effect.
kv9fcr.why: Exhaust gases contribute to smog, acid rain and the greenhouse effect (effetto serra).

tbw24t.q: Air pollution caused by vehicles is mostly due to exhaust gases produced by combustion inside the engine.
tbw24t.why: Most vehicle pollution comes from exhaust gases (gas di scarico) created when fuel burns inside the engine.

15omakx.q: Air pollution caused by vehicles depends mainly on the humidity in the air.
15omakx.why: Vehicle pollution depends on engine combustion and exhaust gases, not on air humidity.

xzyx50.q: Air pollution caused by motor vehicles can decrease if the weight of the vehicle is reduced.
xzyx50.why: A lighter vehicle needs less energy, burns less fuel and therefore emits fewer pollutants.

fjq2xz.q: Air pollution caused by motor vehicles can be reduced by choosing electric, methane or LPG-powered vehicles.
fjq2xz.why: Electric, methane (metano) or LPG (GPL) vehicles emit fewer pollutants than conventional petrol or diesel ones.

c777ql.q: Air pollution caused by motor vehicles can decrease if the engine is switched off during a prolonged stop.
c777ql.why: With the engine off during a long stop, no fuel is burned and no exhaust is emitted.

1d02k8i.q: Air pollution caused by motor vehicles can be reduced by avoiding using the vehicle for short trips.
1d02k8i.why: On short trips the engine stays cold and burns more fuel and pollutes more, so avoiding them by car helps.

1t48ajw.q: Driving a vehicle that emits too many polluting exhaust gases can be punished with an administrative fine and withdrawal of the registration document.
1t48ajw.why: Driving a vehicle with excessive emissions brings an administrative fine and withdrawal of the registration document (carta di circolazione).

1t6mig4.q: Air pollution caused by motor vehicles can decrease if luggage is placed on the roof of the car.
1t6mig4.why: Roof luggage increases air resistance, raising fuel use and emissions; luggage should go inside the vehicle.

1jpgsp0.q: Air pollution caused by motor vehicles can decrease if you always drive in low gears.
1jpgsp0.why: Low gears raise engine revs, increasing fuel use and emissions; shifting to the highest suitable gear early is better.

wgzuq6.q: Air pollution caused by motor vehicles can decrease if you accelerate while holding the clutch pedal down.
wgzuq6.why: Accelerating with the clutch pressed makes the engine rev freely, wasting fuel and polluting without driving the wheels.

9jlcoq.q: Air pollution caused by motor vehicles can decrease if you accelerate with the gearbox in neutral.
9jlcoq.why: Revving in neutral (folle) spins the engine uselessly, wasting fuel and increasing emissions.

1sj8cb5.q: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, the air filter must be replaced periodically.
1sj8cb5.why: A dirty air filter worsens combustion and raises fuel use and emissions, so it must be replaced regularly.

1bkxb3d.q: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles with a diesel engine, the fuel system (injection pump and injectors) must be checked periodically.
1bkxb3d.why: Faulty injection pump or injectors worsen diesel combustion and emissions, so they need regular checks.

zdxwo2.q: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, the engine must be checked if the exhaust smoke is too dark.
zdxwo2.why: Overly dark exhaust smoke signals a fault and poor combustion, so the engine should be checked.

49ga37.q: To reduce air pollution, you must not accelerate and brake often while driving.
49ga37.why: Frequent acceleration and braking raise fuel use and emissions; smooth, steady driving pollutes less.

1qe25ox.q: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must give a short burst of the accelerator before pressing the clutch to change gear.
1qe25ox.why: A throttle blip before changing gear wastes fuel and increases emissions.

a9fzsk.q: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, the engine must be used at maximum revs.
a9fzsk.why: At maximum revs the engine burns more fuel and emits more; medium revs and higher gears pollute less.

16ig6tm.q: To reduce air pollution caused by the vehicle's exhaust gases, the pollen filter must be replaced periodically.
16ig6tm.why: The pollen filter cleans the cabin air and has no effect on the exhaust gases the engine emits.

1v8wxje.q: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, the oil filter must be replaced at every change of season.
1v8wxje.why: The oil filter is replaced according to the manufacturer's maintenance schedule, not each season.

1mttbdn.q: To save fuel and protect the environment from air pollution, it is advisable to use the air conditioning as little as possible and only when really needed.
1mttbdn.why: The air conditioning draws power from the engine and raises fuel use and emissions, so use it only when needed.

st2zfj.q: To protect the environment from air pollution, you must press the accelerator pedal several times when the vehicle is cold.
st2zfj.why: Pumping the accelerator on a cold engine wastes fuel and pollutes more; move off gently instead.

19yln08.q: To protect the environment from air pollution, you must press the accelerator pedal fully several times so that the vehicle quickly reaches its operating temperature.
19yln08.why: Flooring the accelerator on a cold engine raises fuel use and emissions; the engine warms up better by driving smoothly.

1qezife.q: To protect the environment from air and noise pollution, you must press the accelerator pedal fully when changing gear.
1qezife.why: Pressing the accelerator fully during a gear change needlessly increases fuel use, emissions and noise.

1pi8iao.q: To limit fuel consumption, it is better to close the windows when travelling at medium-high speeds, because turbulence inside the passenger compartment can slow the vehicle down.
1pi8iao.why: At medium-high speed open windows increase aerodynamic drag and fuel use, so keep them closed.

1koutnk.q: To limit fuel consumption it is better not to use the roof rack, but to put the luggage inside the vehicle.
1koutnk.why: A roof rack increases air resistance and fuel use, so luggage is better placed inside the vehicle.

hz6z0k.q: Travelling with a thick layer of snow on the roof of the vehicle increases fuel consumption.
hz6z0k.why: The weight and bulk of snow on the roof increase drag and fuel use; clear it before setting off.

usc536.q: Travelling at high speed with the vehicle's sunroof open increases fuel consumption.
usc536.why: An open sunroof at high speed creates turbulence and drag, which increases fuel consumption.

t4w9ap.q: In the event of a prolonged stop in a tunnel because of a queue of vehicles, it is harmful to health to use the air recirculation control inside the vehicle.
t4w9ap.why: In a tunnel queue, recirculation keeps outside exhaust fumes from entering the cabin, so it is useful, not harmful.

114xn8m.q: Vehicles meeting the "Euro 4" anti-pollution standard emit a larger quantity of polluting gases than those approved under the "Euro 0" standard.
114xn8m.why: A higher Euro level means stricter limits, so a Euro 4 vehicle emits fewer pollutants than a Euro 0 one.

98e8tm.q: Towing a trailer does not increase fuel consumption.
98e8tm.why: A trailer adds weight and air resistance, so fuel consumption rises.

15threk.q: Driving a vehicle whose engine and exhaust (silencer) have been modified can lead to heavy administrative fines.
15threk.why: Modifying the engine and silencer (marmitta) without approval is illegal and carries heavy administrative fines.

1p7x6qp.q: It is permitted to freely modify the engine and exhaust (silencer) of a vehicle in order to reduce air pollution.
1p7x6qp.why: Engine and silencer changes are allowed only if officially approved, even when meant to cut pollution.

gp4xqn.q: It is forbidden to pour the vehicle's cooling circuit antifreeze into the sewer, because it may not be biodegradable.
gp4xqn.why: Antifreeze may not be biodegradable and pollutes, so it must be disposed of properly, not poured into the sewer.

1o38bsx.q: Abandoning a car battery on the road or on the ground can cause serious damage to the environment and the groundwater below.
1o38bsx.why: A battery contains lead and acid, toxic substances that pollute soil and groundwater (falde acquifere).

ino7d2.q: When buying a car battery, you can hand the exhausted (used) one to the retailer, who will collect it at no additional cost.
ino7d2.why: When buying a new battery you can return the old one to the seller, who takes it back free of charge.

15nc4e9.q: The owner of a vehicle who intends to scrap or demolish it must hand it to a collection centre for decommissioning (authorised scrapyard).
15nc4e9.why: A vehicle to be scrapped must go to an authorised collection centre (autodemolitore) for safe decommissioning.

1vuegry.q: When disposing of engine oil, you must avoid it coming into contact with the skin for a prolonged time.
1vuegry.why: Used oil is harmful to the skin, so handle it carefully and avoid prolonged contact.

1m72r1o.q: The discharge of organic waste and dirty water from motorhomes (autocaravan) must take place at the appropriate hygiene and sanitary disposal facilities.
1m72r1o.why: Motorhome (autocaravan) waste and dirty water may only be emptied at proper sanitary disposal points.

xuamu1.q: Abandoning hazardous or toxic waste on the ground (oils, liquids, residues from repairs or replacements) is not penalised.
xuamu1.why: Dumping hazardous or toxic waste on the ground is prohibited and punished.

mx8rsk.q: To demolish or scrap a vehicle, it must be handed over exclusively to the manufacturer's dealer.
mx8rsk.why: A vehicle can go to any authorised collection centre, not only to the manufacturer's dealer.

18bs1n6.q: It is forbidden to damage road works and road installations.
18bs1n6.why: The Highway Code prohibits damaging road structures and installations.

wqxbtn.q: It is forbidden to throw objects and waste from moving vehicles.
wqxbtn.why: Throwing objects or waste from a moving vehicle is prohibited because it dirties the road and can be dangerous.

1oh2rbb.q: It is forbidden to dirty the carriageway by depositing waste.
1oh2rbb.why: Leaving rubbish on the carriageway (carreggiata) is prohibited.

e8y2fs.q: It is forbidden to enter roads with vehicle wheels dirty with mud.
e8y2fs.why: Entering a road with muddy wheels is prohibited because it dirties the road and creates a hazard.

1myie4t.q: On all roads it is forbidden to practise driving.
1myie4t.why: Driving practice is banned only on certain roads, such as motorways, not on all roads.

1mu6wxc.q: On all roads, audible warning devices (horns, trumpets) are prohibited.
1mu6wxc.why: The horn ban applies only in built-up areas, except for immediate danger; elsewhere it may be used to signal.

ph34a9.q: On all roads, the transit of vehicles longer than 10 m is prohibited.
ph34a9.why: Vehicles over 10 m long are barred only where a sign says so, not on all roads.

1q460hg.q: It is forbidden to park in residential areas.
1q460hg.why: Parking is not generally forbidden in residential areas; local signs regulate it.
